issues.finding: Removing SMILES, descriptors and chemical prose measures a bundled explicit-input effect; it does not isolate pretrained chemical knowledge. Retained predictions/CW/similarity may still encode chemistry.
issues.requested_change: Name estimand as the conditional contribution of explicit SMILES/descriptor/chemical-text visibility; specify which derived numeric signals are held fixed. Do not interpret it as all chemical knowledge removed or as uniquely pretrained knowledge.
issues.resolution: Estimand narrowed to explicit SMILES/descriptor/chemical-text input package, with q50/quantile/CW/Morgan numeric signals held; pretrained-knowledge isolation explicitly disclaimed.

issues.finding: Five-seed directional thresholds have no fixed rule for pooling early/late states or choosing among factorial main effects/interactions.
issues.requested_change: Define primary experiment2 effect as within-seed average across the two prespecified states, with stage interaction secondary; predefine chemical-input and feedback main effects in experiment3 and treat interaction as exploratory, rather than choosing a favorable contrast post hoc.
issues.resolution: Critic primary effect now equal-weights two states within seed before five-seed aggregation. Feedback is factorial primary, explicit-structure package secondary, interaction exploratory.
